news.title: US Permitting Reform Clears the Senate: Solar and Storage Gain Certainty as a Year-End House Vote Looms [SMM Analysis]
news.description: The US Senate passed the BAAJA permitting reform bill 62-33. Its review deadlines, 150-day window for legal challenges and protections for permitted projects would reduce policy risk for solar and storage projects. The House must pass the bill unchanged before the current Congress ends, or it will have to be reintroduced in the new Congress.
